title: The Tale of the Second Brother, Baqbaqa the Paraplegic

paragraphs.en: Baqbaqa, my second brother who was paraplegic, encountered an old woman while on business. She proposed taking him to a pleasant place with a handsome house, a garden, clear wine, and a beautiful lady. Baqbaqa agreed without asking many questions.
paragraphs.zh: 我的二哥巴克巴卡是个瘫痪患者，他在外出办事时遇到了一位老妇人。老妇人提议带他去一个风景宜人的地方，那里有幢气派的房屋、一座花园、清澈的美酒以及一位美丽的女士。巴克巴卡没有多问就答应了。

paragraphs.en: The old woman led him to the mansion where servants were present. When they saw Baqbaqa, one of them asked, "What are you doing here?" But the old woman replied that he was a workman needed there.
paragraphs.zh: 老妇人将他带到了有仆人侍候的府邸。见到巴克巴卡后，其中一个仆人问道：“你来这里做什么？”但老妇人回答说，他是被需要来工作的工人。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad was interrupted by dawn. Dinarzad asked, "What a fascinating tale! What will you tell us next night if the king spares you?"
paragraphs.zh: 天边已泛起了鱼肚白，沙海拉罕被打断了。第纳尔扎德问道：“真是引人入胜的故事！如果国王饶恕你，你明天晚上会给我们讲什么呢？”
第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德开口说道：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, I heard that the tailor told the king of China what the barber had said to his guests. The barber claimed he overheard the caliph speaking privately.
paragraphs.zh: 贤明的国王啊，我听说裁缝向中国国王转述了理发师对客人们说的话。理发师声称他无意中听到了哈里发的私密谈话。

paragraphs.en: My brother was greeted by a slap on the neck from the lady as he accepted her cup. Despite his anger, he returned to sit when the old woman winked at him. The lady then ordered her maids to hit my brother again, all the while praising his submission.
paragraphs.zh: 我的哥哥在接受那女士递来的杯子时，被她/ 地一巴掌拍在了脖子上。尽管他怒气冲冲，还是在老妇人向他眨眼示意后回到了座位。随后，那女士命令她的侍女再次打了我哥哥，并且一边夸奖他的顺从。

paragraphs.en: She instructed them to perfume and sprinkle rosewater on him, saying, "May God reward you for your patience." My brother responded humbly, "My lady, I am your slave."
paragraphs.zh: 她吩咐他们用玫瑰水给他洒香水，并说道：“愿真主因你们的耐心而奖赏你们。”我的哥哥谦卑地回答道：“夫人，我乃您的奴仆。”

paragraphs.en: The lady commanded her maids to sing loudly, which they did. Then she called a maid, instructing her to take my brother with her. As the old woman rose to accompany them, my brother asked, "What does she wish this maid to do?"
paragraphs.zh: 夫人命令侍女们大声唱歌，侍女们照做了。随后她叫来一个侍女，吩咐她带我哥哥一起去。见老妇人起身陪同她们，我哥哥问道：“她让这个侍女去做什么？”

paragraphs.en: The old woman replied, "Nothing but good—she wishes to dye your eyebrows and remove your mustaches." My brother worried about the plucking of his mustache, but the old woman warned him against crossing her.
paragraphs.zh: 老妇人回答说：“一切都很顺利——她想给你染眉毛，拔掉胡子。”我哥哥担心拔胡子的事，但老妇人警告他不要违逆她。

paragraphs.en: My brother submitted as the maid dyed his eyebrows and removed his mustaches. Then he was shaved by another maid at the lady's instruction to be beardless. The old woman assured my brother that this was a sign of the lady’s passion for him, urging patience as his wish would soon come true.
paragraphs.zh: 我的兄弟甘拜下风，任由女仆为他描眉剃须。随后，在那位小姐的吩咐下，另一位女仆给他刮了胡须，使他变得光洁如初。老妇人向我兄弟保证，这正是小姐对他情深意长的标志，并催促他耐心等待，因为他的心愿很快就会实现。

paragraphs.en: The tailor told the king that his brother was asked by an old woman to undress completely. She intended to run away while he chased her until his penis became erect. The woman then invited him to chase her, stripping down herself except for her trousers.
paragraphs.zh: 裁缝告诉国王，他的弟弟被一位老妇人要求完全脱衣。她打算趁他追赶时逃跑，直到他的阳具勃起。随后，那女人邀请他继续追捕，自己也脱掉了身上的衣物，只留下裤子。

paragraphs.en: With intense desire, the brother ran after her like a madman. She led him into a dark area where he stepped on a soft spot, causing him to fall into the middle of a leather market.
paragraphs.zh: 怀着强烈的渴望，哥哥像疯了一样追了上去。她将他带进一个昏暗的地方，哥哥踩到了一个柔软的部位，不慎跌入了一个皮革市场之中。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad continued her story the next night, saying that when morning came, she fell silent. Dinarzad remarked, "What an intriguing tale!" Shahrazad replied, "Wait until tomorrow night; I have many more stories to share if you spare me."
paragraphs.zh: 沙海拉扎德在第二天晚上继续讲述她的故事，当晨光初现时，她突然沉默了。迪纳札德说道：“真是引人入胜的故事啊！”沙海拉扎德回答道：“等到明天晚上再听吧；如果你能饶恕我，我还有很多精彩的故事要与你分享。”

paragraphs.en: When they found Baqbaqa naked and disheveled, they mocked him, beat him with hides, and left him unconscious. They then carried him on an ass to the city gate. The police chief questioned them, learned of Baqbaqa's fall from the vizier’s house, and punished him by lashing and banishing him from Baghdad.
paragraphs.zh: 当他们发现巴克巴卡赤身裸体、狼狈不堪时，不仅嘲笑他，还用皮鞭抽打他，直到他昏迷不醒。随后，他们将他绑在一匹驴上，送到城门。警察局长审问了他们，得知巴克巴卡是从 vizier 的府邸摔落下来的消息后，便下令鞭打了他，并将其驱逐出 Baghdad。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad was interrupted that night, but promised Dinarzad she would tell a more intriguing tale the next night if the king spared her life.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，沙海拉扎德被国王中断了讲述，但她向丁纳兹达承诺，如果国王饶她一命，她会在第二天晚上讲一个更加引人入胜的故事。

paragraphs.en: The following night, Shahrazad began: She heard that the tailor told the Chinese king what the barber had shared with his guests about the caliph.
paragraphs.zh: 当晚，沙海拉罕开口说道：她听说裁缝向中国国王透露了理发师与客人分享的关于哈里发的消息。
